existing_original_findings.fact: Event6 starts run_workers: join object+8 before starting command workers 0 and1; join return ignored.
existing_original_findings.limit: Successful join can wait for auth tail; actual success, process state and USB-to-event binding not established.

existing_original_findings.fact: Worker.cancel targets Thread objects +8/+16; Thread.cancel calls pthread_cancel without any join.
existing_original_findings.limit: No bounded cancellation latency or completed writers established by request return.

existing_original_findings.fact: Worker.join invokes two plain pthread_join wrappers, then mass-data cleanup and plugin unload; wrapper returns are ignored.
existing_original_findings.limit: No internal timeout; cleanup/unload bodies and all external threads not closed by this review.

existing_original_findings.fact: Both stop callbacks log nonzero status, then still clear USB state to0; async callback also pushes event3, whose handler invokes join before callbacks.
existing_original_findings.limit: State0 or a callback alone is not successful interface stop or successful join proof.

existing_original_findings.fact: Finalize can wait for state1, stop state2, join workers, wait for state3, virtual close, destroy USB and Senser interfaces. SenserIfStop then removes handler/closes channel.
existing_original_findings.limit: spin_wait_while has usleep(10) retry and no deadline; pthread_join is plain join. Actual time bounds or return-to-MSC not proved.

existing_original_findings.fact: NinThread and SenserThread call setcancelstate with0, testcancel, then state1 before receive/work; numeric arguments pinned.
existing_original_findings.interpretation: Under normal Linux pthread constants this is an enabled checkpoint followed by a disabled section; a host timeout cannot assume immediate camera cancellation.
existing_original_findings.limit: Actual libc behavior, I/O unblock and cancellation cleanup not executed or wholly traced.

existing_original_findings.fact: Fixed PMCA stop swallows GenericUsbException; local finally starts after service authenticate, leaving auth failure outside that cleanup.
existing_original_findings.limit: No conclusion that all failures leave service mode, nor that physical damage occurred.

next_safe_implementation: Implement bounded IOKit control/bulk operations inside the native owner process; never cast a libusb handle or export raw root pointers to user Python.
Preserve exact lengths, positive driver timeouts, actual-return/inflight separation and no retry/reset/clear-halt fallback.
Bind current same-camera handle generation and interface pipe mapping, then integrate typed IPC and the already-reviewed single-session policy.
Keep authentication and camera-file access disabled until a concrete complete entry/read/exit plan covers observed side effects and separate user authority.
